title: 嘉靖十六年雲南鄉試錄
嘉靖十六年雲南鄉試錄
text:
雲南鄉試錄序
嘉靖丁酉歲秋八月廼天下
賓興期先寔貴州士合試於
滇至是用言者
請貴州特設科論士雲南則增解
額總若干名而掄材擢秀仍
舊貫焉疏下禮部議上其事
===
制曰可於戲可以仰見
國家豐芑之遺
神化漸被之遠
聖天子作人之盛矣廷相也不佞
竊惟周書論辭貴乎體要尼
父陳訓惡乎異端古人為文
率皆明道德經世務若太羹
punctuated:
雲南鄉試錄序

嘉靖丁酉歲秋八月，廼天下賓興期。先寔貴州士合試於滇，至是用言者請，貴州特設科論士，雲南則增解額總若干名，而掄材擢秀仍舊貫焉。疏下禮部，議上其事。制曰：「可。」於戲！可以仰見國家豐芑之遺、神化漸被之遠、聖天子作人之盛矣！

廷相也不佞，竊惟《周書》論辭，貴乎體要；尼父陳訓，惡乎異端。古人為文，率皆明道德、經世務，若太羹
translation_en:
Preface to the Record of the Yunnan Provincial Examination

In the eighth month of autumn in the dingyou year of Jiajing [1537], the time arrived for the realm-wide ceremonial selection of worthy men. Previously, candidates from Guizhou had taken the examination jointly with those in Yunnan. Now, following a proposal submitted to the throne, Guizhou was specially authorized to hold its own examination to assess its candidates, while Yunnan’s quota of provincial graduates was increased to a total of a certain number. The selection of talented and outstanding men otherwise continued according to established practice. The memorial was referred to the Ministry of Rites, which deliberated and submitted its recommendation. The Emperor’s decree reads: “Approved.” Ah! Here we may reverently discern the state’s continuation of the legacy of “flourishing millet”—the nurturing of talent—the far-reaching spread of its wondrous transforming influence, and the flourishing of the sage Son of Heaven’s cultivation of men of worth!

I, Tingxiang, though lacking ability, humbly reflect that the Documents of Zhou, in discussing language, prizes substance and essentials; and that Father Ni [Confucius], in setting forth his teachings, rejects heterodox doctrines. The writings of the ancients generally elucidated the Way and virtue and addressed the affairs of the world, resembling the unseasoned broth of the great sacrifice…

title: 嘉靖十六年雲南鄉試錄
text:
玄酒然如典謨之明白易知
是已初無險僻艱深之狀竒
澁茁軋而不可讀也嘗莊誦
高皇帝聖語曰諸葛孔明出師表
不事雕刻而誠意溢出至今
使人誦之忠義感激又曰近
世文士不究道德之本不達
===
當世之務辭雖艱深意實淺
近卽使過相如揚雄何裨實
用大哉
王言真醇淵懿濟濟多士藹然嚮
風
聖子神孫益隆紹述百六十年來
海内髦俊抱墳策而頌太平
punctuated: 玄酒然，如典謨之明白易知是已，初無險僻艱深之狀，竒澁茁軋而不可讀也。嘗莊誦高皇帝聖語曰：「諸葛孔明出師表，不事雕刻而誠意溢出，至今使人誦之，忠義感激。」又曰：「近世文士，不究道德之本，不達當世之務，辭雖艱深，意實淺近。卽使過相如、揚雄，何裨實用？」大哉，王言！真醇淵懿，濟濟多士，藹然嚮風。聖子神孫，益隆紹述。百六十年來，海内髦俊，抱墳策而頌太平
translation_en: …and plain water offered as ritual wine: the clarity and accessibility of the Canons and Counsels exemplify this. There was originally nothing abstruse or difficult about such writing, nothing strange, opaque, or awkwardly contorted [?] that would make it unreadable. I once reverently recited these sagely words of Emperor Gao: “Zhuge Kongming’s Memorial on Sending Out the Army employs no elaborate ornamentation, yet sincerity overflows from it. Even today, those who recite it are deeply stirred by its loyalty and righteousness.” He also said: “Literary men of recent times neither investigate the foundations of the Way and virtue nor understand the affairs of their own age. Though their language is difficult and obscure, their meaning is actually shallow. Even if they surpassed Sima Xiangru and Yang Xiong, what contribution would they make to practical affairs?” How great are these royal words! Genuine, pure, profound, and admirable, they inspired the assembled multitude of scholars to turn eagerly toward their influence. His sagely sons and divine grandsons further exalted the work of continuing and carrying forward his legacy. For one hundred and sixty years, outstanding talents throughout the realm, holding the ancient classics and writings and celebrating the Great Peace…

title: 嘉靖十六年雲南鄉試錄
text:
者咸布帛菽粟之雅而一時
名卿碩輔代工熈載以復惇
大成裕之治者胥此焉出誠
科目之榮也猗歟休哉迨我
皇上敬天法
祖崇雅黜浮敬一之箴洪範之序
煥乎堯文而太朴未斲所以
===
風天下之士習者乆矣頃年
復用禮官議申禁鈎棘浮藻
之文俾典衡者式焉
天詔渙頒校黌易轍雲南雖古六
詔邊陲而士生其間搦管濡
毫亦皆知脫雕麗而就質素
剪華彩而務雅馴不佞於供
punctuated: 者，咸布帛菽粟之雅，而一時名卿碩輔，代工熈載，以復惇大成裕之治者，胥此焉出，誠科目之榮也。猗歟休哉！迨我皇上敬天法祖，崇雅黜浮，《敬一之箴》《洪範之序》，煥乎堯文，而太朴未斲，所以風天下之士習者乆矣。頃年復用禮官議，申禁鈎棘浮藻之文，俾典衡者式焉。天詔渙頒，校黌易轍。雲南雖古六詔邊陲，而士生其間，搦管濡毫，亦皆知脫雕麗而就質素，剪華彩而務雅馴。不佞於供
translation_en:
…all possess the unadorned refinement of cloth, beans, and grain. The eminent ministers and great statesmen of each age, who discharge Heaven’s work, bring their undertakings to fruition, and thereby restore a government of generosity and abundance, have all emerged from this system. This is truly the glory of the examinations. Ah, how splendid!

Our present Emperor reveres Heaven and models himself upon his ancestors, exalting refinement and rejecting superficiality. His Admonition on Reverent Single-mindedness (Jingyi zhen) and Preface to the Great Plan (Hongfan xu) shine with Yao’s cultural brilliance while preserving primordial simplicity unhewn. Through these he has long guided the scholarly practices of the realm. In recent years, moreover, he adopted the recommendations of the ritual officials and reiterated the prohibition against convoluted and superficially ornate writing, directing those charged with judging examination essays to follow this rule. The imperial edict was widely promulgated, and the schools changed course.

Although Yunnan is the frontier region of the ancient Six Zhao, the scholars born there, when they grasp their brushes and moisten their tips, all know to abandon elaborate beauty and embrace plain substance, to pare away flowery embellishment and strive for refinement and propriety. I, unworthy as I am, while engaged in…

title: 嘉靖十六年雲南鄉試錄
text:
事之頃得而縱觀之於易義
之文見庖犧之故焉於書義
之文見陶唐之渾焉於詩禮
春秋義之文見天理民彛之
常焉其誥表策判之文胥稱
是雖熟而為
宗廟之粢盛裁而為
===
朝廷衮黼也亦宜矣於戲盛哉
間有競巧趨新靡麗騰口摇
筆而散珠動墨而横錦務為
炳炳烺烺以投主司之肯首
是殆經賊文妖無補於治者
則黜之不少貸焉於戲諸君
子生長遐方遭逢
punctuated:
事之頃，得而縱觀之。於《易》義之文，見庖犧之故焉；於《書》義之文，見陶唐之渾焉；於《詩》《禮》《春秋》義之文，見天理民彛之常焉。其誥、表、策、判之文，胥稱是。雖熟而為宗廟之粢盛，裁而為朝廷衮黼也，亦宜矣。於戲，盛哉！
間有競巧趨新，靡麗騰口，摇筆而散珠，動墨而横錦，務為炳炳烺烺，以投主司之肯首，是殆經賊文妖、無補於治者，則黜之，不少貸焉。於戲！諸君子生長遐方，遭逢
translation_en:
…while carrying out my duties, I had the opportunity to read them at length. In the essays on the meaning of the Book of Changes, I saw the ancient ways of Paoxi; in those on the Book of Documents, the pristine wholeness of Taotang. In those on the Book of Odes, the Book of Rites, and the Spring and Autumn Annals, I saw the enduring principles of Heaven and the constant norms of human relations. Their proclamations, memorials, policy essays, and legal judgments were all commensurate with these. Even if ripened into sacrificial grain for the ancestral temples or cut into ceremonial robes embroidered with dragons and axe patterns for the court, they would indeed be fitting. Ah, how splendid!
Among them, however, were some who vied in cleverness and pursued novelty, pouring ornate phrases from their mouths, scattering pearls with a shake of the brush and spreading brocade with a stroke of ink. They strove for dazzling brilliance to win an approving nod from the presiding examiners. Such writings were surely robbers of the Classics and monstrosities of literary composition, contributing nothing to good government; these I rejected without the slightest indulgence. Ah, you gentlemen, born and raised in this distant region, have encountered…

title: 嘉靖十六年雲南鄉試錄
text:
盛際亦旣以其辭之醇且朴者
得雋固榮矣尚相與鞭策淬
礪排闥古聖賢純懿之域而
優入焉則主司者之望也毋
徒以地之遠而自鄙夷斯善
矣何也孟子曰舜生於諸馮
東夷之人也文王生於岐周
===
西夷之人也彼丈夫也我丈
夫也有爲者亦若是諸君子
顧力行何如耳毋自諉曰辭
達而已矣海濱之子奚足以
語此則幸也是役也合提學
副使陳煥所簡經生之英而
拔其尤擇其文爾雅渾厚者
punctuated:
盛際，亦旣以其辭之醇且朴者得雋，固榮矣。尚相與鞭策淬礪，排闥古聖賢純懿之域而優入焉，則主司者之望也。毋徒以地之遠而自鄙夷，斯善矣。何也？孟子曰：「舜生於諸馮，東夷之人也；文王生於岐周，西夷之人也。」彼丈夫也，我丈夫也，有爲者亦若是。諸君子顧力行何如耳，毋自諉曰：「辭達而已矣，海濱之子奚足以語此？」則幸也。
是役也，合提學副使陳煥所簡經生之英而拔其尤，擇其文爾雅渾厚者
translation_en:
…in this flourishing age, you have already distinguished yourselves through the purity and simplicity of your writing: this is assuredly an honor. Yet you should continue to spur one another on and temper and refine yourselves, pushing open the gates to the realm of the ancient sages’ and worthies’ pure and admirable virtue and entering it with ease. This is what those presiding over the examination hope for. Do not disparage yourselves merely because your homeland is distant; that would be well. Why? Mencius said: “Shun was born in Zhufeng and was a man of the eastern Yi; King Wen was born in Qizhou and was a man of the western Yi.” They were men, and I too am a man; those who exert themselves can likewise become such as they. For you gentlemen, it depends only on how earnestly you put this into practice. Do not excuse yourselves by saying: “It is enough that our words convey their meaning. How could sons of the seacoast be worthy to discuss such things?” If you refrain from this, it will be a blessing.
For this examination, we assembled the outstanding students of the Classics selected by Chen Huan, Education Intendant and Surveillance Vice Commissioner, and chose the finest among them, selecting those whose compositions were elegant and correct, substantial and profound…

title: 嘉靖十六年雲南鄉試錄
text:
登諸冊名為雲南鄉試錄肇
今制也廷相與訓導穆旺濫竿考
試官教諭沈仁戴希顥訓導
許士德為同考試官分經供
事維謹皆四方之良也迺若
工部右侍郎潘鑑奉
命督木崇重賢科征南將軍黔國
===
公沐朝輔新握兵符雅尚文
事巡撫雲南右僉都御史汪
文盛經略邊鄙加志儒林監
臨則巡按雲南監察御史陰
汝登提調則雲南左布政使
王俊民右參政葉珩監試則
雲南按察副使程旦僉事戴
punctuated: 登諸冊，名為《雲南鄉試錄》，肇今制也。廷相與訓導穆旺濫竿考試官，教諭沈仁、戴希顥、訓導許士德為同考試官，分經供事維謹，皆四方之良也。迺若工部右侍郎潘鑑奉命督木，崇重賢科；征南將軍黔國公沐朝輔新握兵符，雅尚文事；巡撫雲南右僉都御史汪文盛經略邊鄙，加志儒林。監臨則巡按雲南監察御史陰汝登，提調則雲南左布政使王俊民、右參政葉珩，監試則雲南按察副使程旦、僉事戴
translation_en:
…entered them in a volume entitled Record of the Yunnan Provincial Examination, thereby inaugurating the present practice. I, Tingxiang, together with Assistant Instructor Mu Wang, unworthily served [?] as Examiners. Instructors Shen Ren and Dai Xihao and Assistant Instructor Xu Shide served as Associate Examiners. Assigned responsibilities by Classic, they performed their duties most diligently; all were worthy men drawn from the various regions.
As for Pan Jian, Right Vice Minister of Works, he was supervising timber procurement under imperial command and held the examination for selecting worthy men in high esteem. Mu Chaofu, General Who Subdues the South and Duke of Qian, had newly assumed military command and had a longstanding regard for literary affairs. Wang Wensheng, Grand Coordinator of Yunnan and Right Assistant Censor-in-chief, managed the frontier regions and devoted particular attention to the community of scholars. The Supervising Official was Yin Rudeng, Investigating Censor serving as Regional Inspector of Yunnan. The Proctors were Wang Junmin, Left Provincial Administration Commissioner of Yunnan, and Ye Heng, Right Provincial Administration Vice Commissioner. Those overseeing the examination were Cheng Dan, Provincial Surveillance Vice Commissioner of Yunnan, and Provincial Surveillance Assistant Commissioner Dai…

title: 嘉靖十六年雲南鄉試錄
text:
邦正綜理防範則右布政使
李顯左叅政黃祺右叅政車
純按察副使朱方鄭登高任
維賢僉事郭田胡仲誥都指
揮僉事馮立樊泰右叅政胡
德僉事余承業則先期入
賀胥賛厥成收掌試卷則知府
===
梅月姜恩其餘如謄錄對讀
如供給受卷名號靡一例得
以執事書時
王師將問罪交南兵事倥偬而文
闈完整雖乏金碧之輝殊無
湫隘之陋議者以為有司得
貞固之榦云
punctuated:
邦正。綜理防範則右布政使李顯、左叅政黃祺、右叅政車純、按察副使朱方、鄭登高、任維賢、僉事郭田、胡仲誥、都指揮僉事馮立、樊泰。右叅政胡德、僉事余承業則先期入賀，胥賛厥成。收掌試卷則知府梅月、姜恩。其餘如謄錄、對讀，如供給、受卷、名號，靡一例得以執事書。
時王師將問罪交南，兵事倥偬，而文闈完整，雖乏金碧之輝，殊無湫隘之陋。議者以為有司得貞固之榦云。
translation_en:
…Dai Bangzheng. Overall management and security were entrusted to Right Provincial Administration Commissioner Li Xian; Left Administration Vice Commissioner Huang Qi; Right Administration Vice Commissioner Che Chun; Surveillance Vice Commissioners Zhu Fang, Zheng Denggao, and Ren Weixian; Surveillance Assistant Commissioners Guo Tian and Hu Zhonggao; and Assistant Regional Military Commissioners Feng Li and Fan Tai. Right Administration Vice Commissioner Hu De and Surveillance Assistant Commissioner Yu Chengye had gone to court beforehand to offer congratulations; all assisted in bringing the undertaking to completion. The prefects Mei Yue and Jiang En were responsible for receiving and keeping the examination papers. The remaining personnel, including those responsible for transcription, checking copies against originals, supplies, receiving papers, and names and identification numbers, could not all be recorded uniformly as examination functionaries [?].
At the time, the imperial army was about to undertake a punitive expedition against Jiaonan. Military affairs were pressing, yet the examination compound was fully prepared. Although it lacked the splendor of gold and jade, it was entirely free of the shortcomings of damp, cramped quarters. Commentators considered that the responsible authorities had secured steadfast and capable mainstays.

title: 嘉靖十六年雲南鄉試錄
text:
河南汝寧府上蔡縣儒學敎
諭鄭廷相謹序
punctuated: 河南汝寧府上蔡縣儒學敎諭鄭廷相謹序。
translation_en: Preface respectfully written by Zheng Tingxiang, Instructor of the Confucian School of Shangcai County, Runing Prefecture, Henan.

title: 嘉靖十六年雲南鄉試錄
text:
嘉靖十六年雲南鄉試
監臨官
巡按雲南監察御史陰汝登〔民獻四川内江縣人癸酉貢士〕
提調官
雲南等處承宣布政使司左布政使王俊民〔用章湖廣石首縣人甲戌進士〕
雲南等處承宣布政使司右參政葉珩〔鳴玉福建莆田縣人丁丑進士〕
監試官
雲南等處提刑按察司副使程旦〔孟明直隸歙縣人癸未進士〕
雲南等處提刑按察司僉事戴邦正〔貞卿直隸上海縣人丙戌進士〕
===
考試官
河南汝寧府上蔡縣儒學教諭鄭廷相〔調父湖廣黃岡縣人壬午貢士〕
江西廣信府弋陽縣儒學訓導穆旺〔相甫福建閩縣人辛卯貢士〕
同考試官
河南南陽府桐栢縣儒學教諭沈仁〔子恕福建漳浦縣人辛卯貢士〕
江西廣信府鉛山縣儒學教諭戴希顥〔秀夫廣西柳州衛籍湖廣華容縣人乙卯貢士〕
直隸蘇州府吳江縣儒學訓導許士德〔容甫廣東南海縣人乙酉貢士〕
印卷官
雲南等處承宣布政使司經歷司經歷張壅〔崇德湖廣石首縣人監生〕
punctuated:
嘉靖十六年雲南鄉試

監臨官
巡按雲南監察御史陰汝登〔民獻，四川内江縣人，癸酉貢士〕。

提調官
雲南等處承宣布政使司左布政使王俊民〔用章，湖廣石首縣人，甲戌進士〕。
雲南等處承宣布政使司右參政葉珩〔鳴玉，福建莆田縣人，丁丑進士〕。

監試官
雲南等處提刑按察司副使程旦〔孟明，直隸歙縣人，癸未進士〕。
雲南等處提刑按察司僉事戴邦正〔貞卿，直隸上海縣人，丙戌進士〕。

考試官
河南汝寧府上蔡縣儒學教諭鄭廷相〔調父，湖廣黃岡縣人，壬午貢士〕。
江西廣信府弋陽縣儒學訓導穆旺〔相甫，福建閩縣人，辛卯貢士〕。

同考試官
河南南陽府桐栢縣儒學教諭沈仁〔子恕，福建漳浦縣人，辛卯貢士〕。
江西廣信府鉛山縣儒學教諭戴希顥〔秀夫，廣西柳州衛籍，湖廣華容縣人，乙卯貢士〕。
直隸蘇州府吳江縣儒學訓導許士德〔容甫，廣東南海縣人，乙酉貢士〕。

印卷官
雲南等處承宣布政使司經歷司經歷張壅〔崇德，湖廣石首縣人，監生〕。
translation_en:
Yunnan Provincial Examination, the sixteenth year of Jiajing (1537)

Supervising Official
Yin Rudeng, Investigating Censor on an inspection tour of Yunnan, courtesy name Minxian, was from Neijiang County, Sichuan, and was a tribute scholar (gongshi) of the guiyou year.

Proctors
Wang Junmin, Left Provincial Administration Commissioner of Yunnan, courtesy name Yongzhang, was from Shishou County, Huguang, and was a metropolitan graduate (jinshi) of the jiaxu year.

title: 嘉靖十六年雲南鄉試錄

title: 嘉靖十六年雲南鄉試錄
text:
第壹場
四書
視其所以觀其所由察其所安人焉廋哉
人焉廋哉
天地之道博也厚也高也明也悠也久也
以德服人者中心悅而誠服也如七十子
之服孔子也
易
九二見龍在田利見大人
===
象曰雷在天上大壯君子以非禮弗履
鼓之以雷霆潤之以風雨日月運行一寒
一暑乾道成男坤道成女
履和而至謙尊而光復小而辨於物恒雜
而不厭損先難而後易益長裕而不設
困窮而通井居其所而遷巽稱而隱
書
肇十有二州封十有二山濬川
爾惟德罔小萬邦惟慶
punctuated:
第壹場

四書

視其所以，觀其所由，察其所安，人焉廋哉？人焉廋哉？

天地之道，博也，厚也，高也，明也，悠也，久也。

以德服人者，中心悅而誠服也，如七十子之服孔子也。

易

九二：見龍在田，利見大人。

象曰：「雷在天上，大壯。君子以非禮弗履。」

鼓之以雷霆，潤之以風雨，日月運行，一寒一暑。乾道成男，坤道成女。

履，和而至；謙，尊而光；復，小而辨於物；恒，雜而不厭；損，先難而後易；益，長裕而不設；困，窮而通；井，居其所而遷；巽，稱而隱。

書

肇十有二州，封十有二山，濬川。

爾惟德罔小，萬邦惟慶。
translation_en:
First Session

Four Books

Look at what a person does, observe the course he follows, and examine what he finds peace in. How can he hide? How can he hide?

The Way of Heaven and Earth is broad, substantial, lofty, luminous, far-reaching, and enduring.

When one wins people's submission through virtue, they are pleased in their innermost hearts and submit sincerely, as the seventy disciples submitted to Kongzi (Confucius).

Book of Changes

Nine in the second place: A dragon appears in the field. It is favorable to see the great man.

The Image says: “Thunder above Heaven: Great Strength. Thus the gentleman takes no step contrary to ritual propriety.”

They stir things with thunder and thunderbolts and moisten them with wind and rain. The sun and moon move in their courses, bringing alternately cold and heat. The Way of Qian produces the male; the Way of Kun produces the female.

Treading (Lü) is harmonious and reaches its goal; Modesty (Qian) is honored and radiant; Return (Fu) is small yet discriminates among things; Constancy (Heng) encounters complexity without weariness; Decrease (Sun) brings difficulty first and ease afterward; Increase (Yi) fosters lasting abundance without contrivance; Oppression (Kun) reaches an impasse yet finds passage; the Well (Jing) stays in its place yet extends its influence; the Gentle (Xun) acts fittingly yet remains unobtrusive.

Book of Documents

He first established twelve provinces, marked out twelve mountains, and dredged the rivers.

In your practice of virtue, deem nothing too small; then the myriad states will rejoice.

title: 嘉靖十六年雲南鄉試錄
text:
三八政一曰食二曰貨三曰祀四曰司空
五曰司徒六曰司冦七曰賓八曰師
治民祇懼不敢荒寧
詩
爲絺爲綌服之無斁
瞻彼中原其祁孔有儦儦俟俟或羣或友
悉率左右以燕天子旣張我弓旣挾我
矢發彼小豝殪此大兕以御賓客且以
酌醴
===
王命召伯定申伯之宅登是南邦世執其
功
於皇武王無競維烈允文文王克開厥後
嗣武受之勝殷遏劉耆定爾功
春秋
秋公會衛侯于桃丘弗遇冬十有二月
丙午齊侯衛侯鄭伯來戰于郎〔俱桓公〕
〔十年〕春正月齊人衛人鄭人盟于惡曹
〔桓公十有一年〕
punctuated:
三，八政：一曰食，二曰貨，三曰祀，四曰司空，五曰司徒，六曰司冦，七曰賓，八曰師。
治民祇懼，不敢荒寧。

詩
爲絺爲綌，服之無斁。
瞻彼中原，其祁孔有。儦儦俟俟，或羣或友。悉率左右，以燕天子。旣張我弓，旣挾我矢，發彼小豝，殪此大兕，以御賓客，且以酌醴。
王命召伯，定申伯之宅。登是南邦，世執其功。
於皇武王，無競維烈！允文文王，克開厥後。嗣武受之，勝殷遏劉，耆定爾功。

春秋
秋，公會衛侯于桃丘，弗遇。冬，十有二月，丙午，齊侯、衛侯、鄭伯來戰于郎。〔俱桓公〕〔十年〕春，正月，齊人、衛人、鄭人盟于惡曹。〔桓公十有一年〕
translation_en:
Third, the eight affairs of government: the first is food; the second, goods; the third, sacrifices; the fourth, the Minister of Works; the fifth, the Minister of Education; the sixth, the Minister of Justice; the seventh, guests; and the eighth, the army.
In governing the people, remain reverent and fearful, never daring to lapse into idle ease.

Book of Odes
Make fine and coarse kudzu cloth; wear it without tiring of it.
Look at that broad plain: its animals are truly abundant. They run and stand, some in herds, some in pairs. Lead all those on the left and right to give pleasure to the Son of Heaven. Having drawn our bows and set our arrows ready, we shoot that small sow and fell this great wild bull, to provide for guests and to pour out sweet wine.
The king commanded the Earl of Shao to establish the Earl of Shen’s residence. Raise up this southern state, and maintain its achievements through the generations.
Ah, august King Wu! His achievements are beyond compare! Truly cultured was King Wen, who opened the way for his successors. His heir, King Wu, received his legacy, defeated Yin, and stopped the slaughter, bringing your achievement to completion.

Spring and Autumn Annals
In autumn, the duke went to meet the Marquis of Wei at Taoqiu, but did not encounter him. In winter, in the twelfth month, on the bingwu day, the Marquis of Qi, the Marquis of Wei, and the Earl of Zheng came to wage battle at Lang. 〔Both entries belong to Duke Huan’s〕〔tenth year.〕 In spring, in the first month, men of Qi, Wei, and Zheng made a covenant at E’cao. 〔Duke Huan’s eleventh year.〕

title: 嘉靖十六年雲南鄉試錄
text:
遂伐楚僖公四年諸侯遂救許僖公六年
晉人執鄭伯晉欒書帥師伐鄭成公九年
春叔弓會楚子于陳昭公九年六月叔鞅
如京師昭公二十有二年
禮記
侍坐於先生先生問焉終則對請業則起
請益則起
故聖人參於天地並於鬼神以治政也
廉直勁正莊誠之音作而民肅敬
===
孝子之有深愛者必有和氣有和氣者必
有愉色有愉色者必有婉容
第貳塲
論
先王守禮樂之本
詔誥表内科一道
擬漢選高才生受左氏穀梁春秋古文尚
書毛詩詔建初八年
擬唐以裴度爲中書侍郎同平章事誥〔元〕
punctuated:
遂伐楚，僖公四年。諸侯遂救許，僖公六年。晉人執鄭伯，晉欒書帥師伐鄭，成公九年。春，叔弓會楚子于陳，昭公九年。六月，叔鞅如京師，昭公二十有二年。
禮記
侍坐於先生，先生問焉，終則對；請業則起，請益則起。
故聖人參於天地，並於鬼神，以治政也。
廉直勁正莊誠之音作，而民肅敬。
孝子之有深愛者，必有和氣；有和氣者，必有愉色；有愉色者，必有婉容。
第貳塲
論
先王守禮樂之本。
詔誥表内科一道
擬漢選高才生受《左氏》、《穀梁春秋》、《古文尚書》、《毛詩》詔，建初八年。
擬唐以裴度爲中書侍郎、同平章事誥〔元〕
translation_en:
…then attacked Chu. Fourth year of Duke Xi. The feudal lords then went to the relief of Xu. Sixth year of Duke Xi. The men of Jin seized the Earl of Zheng; Luan Shu of Jin led an army to attack Zheng. Ninth year of Duke Cheng. In spring, Shu Gong met the Viscount of Chu at Chen. Ninth year of Duke Zhao. In the sixth month, Shu Yang went to the royal capital. Twenty-second year of Duke Zhao.

Book of Rites
When seated in attendance upon a teacher, if the teacher asks a question, wait until he has finished before replying. Rise when requesting instruction; rise when requesting further explanation.
Thus the sage forms a triad with Heaven and Earth and stands alongside the ghosts and spirits in conducting government.
When music expressing integrity, uprightness, firmness, rectitude, gravity, and sincerity arises, the people become solemn and respectful.
A filial son who has deep love will certainly have a gentle manner; having a gentle manner, he will certainly have a cheerful expression; having a cheerful expression, he will certainly have a gracious countenance.

Second Session
Discourse
The former kings preserved the foundations of rites and music.

One topic from the categories of edict, proclamation, and memorial
Compose an edict in the manner of the Han dynasty selecting exceptionally talented students to receive instruction in the Zuo Commentary, the Guliang Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals, the Old-Text Book of Documents, and the Mao Book of Odes. Eighth year of Jianchu.
Compose a proclamation in the manner of the Tang dynasty appointing Pei Du Vice Director of the Secretariat and Jointly Manager of Affairs with the Secretariat-Chancellery. 〔Yuan…〕

title: 嘉靖十六年雲南鄉試錄
text:
和十年
擬宋輔臣謝
賜
御製瑞聖園觀稼城南觀麥詩表祥符九年
判語五條
擅勾屬官
隱蔽差役
服舍違式
優恤軍屬
===
冒破物料
第參塲
策五道
問自古聖人首出庶物甞垂製作範圍兩
儀其煥有之章載賡之歌渾噩弘肆光
昭汗簡所謂風行水上爲章于天不可
尚已嗣是炎劉以降趙宋以前誼辟英
君摛辭麗藻代不乏人第無裨化理讀
者病之洪惟我
punctuated:
和十年。
擬宋輔臣謝賜御製瑞聖園觀稼城南觀麥詩表，祥符九年。
判語五條：擅勾屬官、隱蔽差役、服舍違式、優恤軍屬、冒破物料。
第參塲
策五道
問：自古聖人首出庶物，甞垂製作，範圍兩儀。其煥有之章、載賡之歌，渾噩弘肆，光昭汗簡。所謂風行水上，爲章于天，不可尚已。嗣是炎劉以降，趙宋以前，誼辟英君，摛辭麗藻，代不乏人。第無裨化理，讀者病之。洪惟我
translation_en:
…the tenth year of Yuanhe [815].
Compose a memorial in the voice of the Song chief councillors thanking the emperor for bestowing his imperially composed poems on viewing the crops in Ruisheng Garden and viewing the wheat south of the city. Ninth year of Xiangfu [1016].
Five legal judgments: summoning subordinate officials without authorization; concealing persons liable for service duties; clothing and residences that violate prescribed standards; providing preferential relief to military dependants; fraudulently charging materials to expenditure accounts.
Third Session
Five Policy Questions
Question: From antiquity, sages have stood foremost among all beings, establishing institutions and cultural forms that encompass Heaven and Earth. Their splendid writings and songs composed in response were simple and uncontrived, grand and expansive, shining brilliantly in the historical records. They were, as the saying goes, like wind moving over water, forming patterns in Heaven: nothing could surpass them. Thereafter, from the Liu house of Han down through the Zhao house of Song, no age lacked righteous sovereigns and outstanding rulers who displayed their eloquence in beautiful literary compositions. Yet these contributed nothing to moral transformation and good government—a failing readers have deplored. Reverently considering our…

title: 嘉靖十六年雲南鄉試錄
text:
太祖高皇帝堯思舜文赫著簡素賁飾萬物冠
冕百王藏
秘府而播天壤百六十年于茲矣諸士子於
國初儒臣之仰讚
御製文集之珍傳諒心醉服膺久矣其詳著于
篇將轉聞於
上以為法
祖右文之助
問上世聖君事必師古遜志時敏帝學肇
===
開宿衛環列庶常吉士侍御僕從罔匪
正人其講臣固無定職勸學亦無定所
矣廼若白虎石渠講筵有地侍講侍讀
勸學有人至於宋朝經幄彌重其益弘
多備載汗青皆可指述洪惟
皇祖兵戈倥傯不忘文學橫經啓沃典學緝熈
揆之商周不多讓矣迨夫
列聖右文祖孫一道講讀尤詳此固執事者所
願聞也諸生其縷陳之母隱
punctuated:
太祖高皇帝堯思舜文，赫著簡素，賁飾萬物，冠冕百王，藏秘府而播天壤，百六十年于茲矣。諸士子於國初儒臣之仰讚、御製文集之珍傳，諒心醉服膺久矣。其詳著于篇，將轉聞於上，以為法祖右文之助。
問：上世聖君，事必師古，遜志時敏，帝學肇開。宿衛環列，庶常吉士、侍御僕從，罔匪正人。其講臣固無定職，勸學亦無定所矣。廼若白虎、石渠，講筵有地；侍講、侍讀，勸學有人。至於宋朝，經幄彌重，其益弘多，備載汗青，皆可指述。洪惟皇祖兵戈倥傯，不忘文學，橫經啓沃，典學緝熈，揆之商周，不多讓矣。迨夫列聖右文，祖孫一道，講讀尤詳。此固執事者所願聞也。諸生其縷陳之，母隱。
translation_en:
…Emperor Taizu Gao, with the thought of Yao and the literary brilliance of Shun, shone resplendently in the written records, adorned all things, and surpassed the hundred kings. His writings have been preserved in the imperial archives and disseminated throughout the world for one hundred and sixty years now. You candidates have surely long been captivated by and cherished in your hearts the admiring praise offered by the Confucian ministers at the dynasty’s founding and the treasured transmission of the Collected Imperial Writings. Set these matters out fully in your essays, so that they may be conveyed to His Majesty and help him emulate his ancestor and honor literary culture.
Question: The sage rulers of antiquity invariably took antiquity as their model in conducting affairs, humbling their minds and constantly striving to learn: thus imperial learning began. Palace guards stood arrayed around them; the worthy gentlemen serving at court, their attendants, and their servants were all upright men. Their lecturers, however, had no fixed offices, nor was there a fixed place for encouraging learning. With the White Tiger Hall and the Stone Canal Pavilion, there were designated places for scholarly lectures; with Expositors-in-waiting and Readers-in-waiting, there were designated men to encourage learning. By the Song dynasty, still greater importance was attached to the imperial classical lectures, and their benefits were extensive. All this is fully recorded in the histories and can be specifically recounted.
We reverently consider how our imperial ancestor, amid the press of warfare, never neglected literary learning. With the Classics spread before him, he received instruction that opened and enriched his mind; he devoted himself constantly to learning and the cultivation of enlightenment. Measured against the rulers of Shang and Zhou, he scarcely yielded to them. Subsequently, the succession of sage emperors honored literary culture, grandfather and grandsons following the same Way, and their lectures and readings became still more thorough. This is precisely what we who administer this examination wish to hear about. You students should set it out in detail, concealing nothing.

title: 嘉靖十六年雲南鄉試錄
text:
問漢唐宋開創之主悉有佐命翊運之臣
爲之指授而登壇裹瘡而健鬭迨其成
功則圖形畫閣勒碑刻銘河山帶礪天
日在鑒可謂厚且至矣然議者於兹毎
有憾焉得非諸君猶有萬一之鍥薄者
乎我
皇祖龍飛淮甸鹿逐胡元於一時佐命翊運諸
臣手足腹心恩禮無間崇階高爵世耀
簪纓追念存殁
廟庭配享殊無粟髮之可訾議者寧不爲盛德
事哉方今海內宫居而粒食擊壤而歌
遊秋毫皆我
皇祖君臣開創之遺也諸生其揄揚於篇以驗
朝家忠厚之澤
問尚書春秋仲尼裁定雖本古史魯史記
而作不可槩謂之史也自遷固而下二
晉所紀南北所載類有譏評或謂可與
左丘明鴈行可使范曄北面可使陳壽
punctuated:
問：漢唐宋開創之主，悉有佐命翊運之臣，爲之指授而登壇，裹瘡而健鬭。迨其成功，則圖形畫閣，勒碑刻銘，河山帶礪，天日在鑒，可謂厚且至矣。然議者於兹毎有憾焉，得非諸君猶有萬一之鍥薄者乎？我皇祖龍飛淮甸，鹿逐胡元，於一時佐命翊運諸臣，手足腹心，恩禮無間，崇階高爵，世耀簪纓，追念存殁，廟庭配享，殊無粟髮之可訾議者，寧不爲盛德事哉？方今海內宫居而粒食，擊壤而歌遊，秋毫皆我皇祖君臣開創之遺也。諸生其揄揚於篇，以驗朝家忠厚之澤。

問：《尚書》《春秋》，仲尼裁定，雖本古史、魯史記而作，不可槩謂之史也。自遷固而下，二晉所紀，南北所載，類有譏評。或謂可與左丘明鴈行，可使范曄北面，可使陳壽
translation_en:
Question: The founding rulers of the Han, Tang, and Song all had ministers who assisted them in receiving the Mandate and furthered their dynastic fortunes. These ministers mounted the command platform to give direction and fought valiantly with their wounds bound up. Once success was achieved, their portraits were displayed in painted galleries and their achievements inscribed on steles. Their rewards were pledged to endure until the rivers became narrow as belts and the mountains small as whetstones, with Heaven and the sun as witnesses. Such treatment may be called generous and consummate. Yet commentators have repeatedly found cause for regret in this. Could it be that these rulers nevertheless showed some slight degree of harshness and ingratitude?

Our Imperial Ancestor rose like a dragon in the Huai region and contested dominion with the Mongol Yuan. He treated the ministers who assisted his accession and furthered his fortunes as his own limbs and trusted confidants, showing them uninterrupted favor and courtesy. With exalted ranks and lofty titles, their families enjoyed the splendor of official distinction for generations. He remembered both the living and the dead, and honored them with associated sacrifices in the imperial ancestral temple. There was not the slightest ground for criticism. Was this not an act of magnificent virtue? Today, throughout the realm, people live in houses and eat grain, playing at striking the earth, singing, and taking their ease. Every slightest benefit is a legacy of the founding achievements of our Imperial Ancestor and his ministers. You candidates should extol these achievements in your essays, thereby demonstrating the blessings bestowed by the dynasty’s loyalty and generosity.

Question: The Book of Documents and the Spring and Autumn Annals were edited and finalized by Zhongni [Confucius]. Although based on ancient historical records and the historical records of Lu, they cannot simply be classed as histories. From Sima Qian and Ban Gu onward, the accounts of the two Jin dynasties and the records of the Northern and Southern dynasties have generally attracted criticism and appraisal. Some say that a historian could rank alongside Zuo Qiuming, could make Fan Ye face north as his pupil, and could make Chen Shou…

title: 嘉靖十六年雲南鄉試錄
text:
作衙官晉史而下以奴僕命之又謂是
非頗謬於聖人崇勢利而羞貧賤輕仁
義而賤死節或譏其朱紫無別鬼怪詼
諧號稱穢史作史不以難歟迨我
憲皇誕命儒臣本朱子綱目脩續宋元綱目之
書其筆削之公義例之美殆將同符尚
書春秋而陋遷固晉唐之史於下風矣
諸君子沉酣羣史誦法
聖謨舊矣其詳言之毋略
===
問選將而任分之以閫自升陑之師牧野
之役已然矣若漢之高光宋之藝祖是
三君者以雄武之資或混一區宇或光
復舊物其選任之方駕馭之術凡懷鉛
握槧者類能言之可縷數其故歟仰惟
皇祖攘狄驅胡丕成鴻業度越千古當時論兵
馭將之略藏之冊府垂之玉牒赫赫若
前日事焉固臣工之所素講者也方今
逆庸不庭
punctuated:
作衙官，晉史而下，以奴僕命之。又謂是非頗謬於聖人，崇勢利而羞貧賤，輕仁義而賤死節。或譏其朱紫無別，鬼怪詼諧，號稱穢史。作史不以難歟？迨我憲皇誕命儒臣，本朱子綱目，脩續宋元綱目之書，其筆削之公、義例之美，殆將同符尚書、春秋，而陋遷固晉唐之史於下風矣。諸君子沉酣羣史，誦法聖謨舊矣，其詳言之，毋略。

問：選將而任，分之以閫，自升陑之師、牧野之役已然矣。若漢之高光、宋之藝祖，是三君者，以雄武之資，或混一區宇，或光復舊物。其選任之方、駕馭之術，凡懷鉛握槧者類能言之，可縷數其故歟？仰惟皇祖攘狄驅胡，丕成鴻業，度越千古。當時論兵馭將之略，藏之冊府，垂之玉牒，赫赫若前日事焉，固臣工之所素講者也。方今逆庸不庭，
translation_en:
…serve as a subordinate officer, while the histories of the Jin and later periods are assigned the status of slaves and servants. Others say that their judgments of right and wrong diverge considerably from those of the sages: they exalt power and profit and regard poverty and low station as shameful; they slight benevolence and righteousness and disparage dying for one's principles. Some criticize their failure to distinguish vermilion from purple—that is, the correct from the spurious—and their tales of ghosts and marvels and their facetiousness, calling them “filthy histories.” Is writing history not difficult? When our Emperor Xian solemnly commanded his Confucian officials to take Master Zhu's Outline and Details as their basis and compile its continuation for the Song and Yuan, the impartiality of their editorial judgments and the excellence of their principles and conventions were such that the work might well accord with the Book of Documents and the Spring and Autumn Annals, relegating the histories of Sima Qian and Ban Gu and those of the Jin and Tang to an inferior position. You gentlemen have immersed yourselves in the histories and have long recited and taken as your model the sage emperor's designs. Explain these matters in detail; do not be cursory.

Question: Selecting and appointing generals and entrusting them with independent command beyond the palace threshold was already established practice at the time of the army's ascent of Er and the campaign at Muye. Consider Gaozu and Guangwu of the Han and the founding emperor of the Song: endowed with heroic martial ability, these three rulers either unified the realm or restored their former inheritance. Their methods of selection and appointment and their arts of controlling their commanders are matters that virtually anyone who carries a writing lead and holds a writing tablet can discuss. Can you enumerate and explain them in detail? We reverently reflect that our imperial ancestor repelled the Di and drove out the Hu, magnificently accomplishing his great undertaking and surpassing all preceding ages. His strategies for discussing warfare and directing generals are preserved in the imperial archives and transmitted in the imperial records, as vividly manifest as though these were events of yesterday. These are surely matters that officials have habitually studied. At present, the rebel Yong refuses to acknowledge the court's authority…

title: 嘉靖十六年雲南鄉試錄
text:
聖人赫怒遣將授鉞重兵自天而下飲馬富良
之濱勒勲銅柱之表盖有日矣諸生其
悉陳之勿諉曰軍旅之事未之學焉
punctuated: 聖人赫怒，遣將授鉞，重兵自天而下，飲馬富良之濱，勒勲銅柱之表，盖有日矣。諸生其悉陳之，勿諉曰：「軍旅之事，未之學焉。」
translation_en: …His Majesty, in blazing wrath, dispatches generals and confers the battle-axe of command. A mighty army descends from Heaven; surely the day will soon come when it waters its horses on the banks of the Fuliang River and inscribes its achievements upon the bronze pillar. You candidates should set forth your views fully. Do not evade the question by saying, “I have never studied military affairs.”
